description.text: The three Sun & Moon Starter Sets Flareon-GX of Fire, Vaporeon-GX of Water and Jolteon-GX of Lightning, released in Korean on 29 November 2018. Each held a 60-card deck with three holo cards, a two-player playmat, damage counters and markers, a GX marker, a Pokémon coin (first print run only) and a rule book.
